# Related omni models and speech systems

[← Model index](../README.md#models)

**Reviewed as of 2026-09-12 · 12 entries.**

Boundary cases retained for discovery: visual omni models, non-LM multimodal generators and modular voice systems. These entries are counted separately from the main omni/SpeechLM catalog.

**Modalities:** T = text, I = image, V = video, A = general audio, S = speech, M = music, X = other structured modalities. A is a broad label, not a guarantee of every audio task. See the [methodology](../docs/methodology.md) for interaction labels, variant scope and inclusion rules.

Dates below refer to the linked paper or announcement, **not necessarily a weights/API release**. An em dash means no date was established from the reviewed source.

## Model notes

<a id="codi"></a>

### CoDi

Any-to-any generator based on diffusion; retained as an omni predecessor, not counted as a SpeechLM.

<a id="duplex-model"></a>

### Duplex Model

System-level real-time interaction with separately connected speech components.

**Listed variants:** Duplex Model.

<a id="fireredchat"></a>

### FireRedChat

Modular voice-agent framework; not counted as a new unified SpeechLM.

<a id="gemini-omni-flash"></a>

### Gemini Omni Flash

Generates and edits video with native audio; this is not a general spoken dialogue model.

**Listed variants:** gemini-omni-1.1-flash.

<a id="hume-evi-4-mini"></a>

### Hume EVI 4-mini

API interface combines TTS with an external model for language generation.

**Listed variants:** 4-mini.

<a id="qwen-audio-3-0-gen-preview"></a>

### Qwen-Audio-3.0-Gen-Preview

Unified mixed-audio generation; the report describes non-autoregressive diffusion, so this is outside the core SpeechLM count.

**Listed variants:** Preview.

<a id="seed-audio-1-0"></a>

### Seed Audio 1.0

Produces speech, ambience and effects; public description identifies a combined generation framework.

<a id="seed-omni-context-unrolling"></a>

### Seed Omni (Context Unrolling)

The named Omni model includes 3D and hidden representations; audio is not established by the reviewed report.

**Listed variants:** Omni.

<a id="shapellm-omni"></a>

### ShapeLLM-Omni

3D generation/understanding model; no speech modality is established.

<a id="soulx-duplug"></a>

### SoulX-Duplug

Adds full-duplex behavior to existing speech systems; not a standalone generative speech foundation model.

<a id="thinkomni"></a>

### ThinkOmni

Training-free method combining existing models; no new independently trained base model is implied.

<a id="x-talk"></a>

### X-Talk

Combines a reasoning LLM with streaming speech processing and interaction control.
